verdict.rationale: Vendor docs confirm enhanced AV1/HEVC encode and decode support (4:2:2, doubled NVDEC throughput) and hardware media engine improvements from Blackwell, plus mention of livestreaming/real-time editing use cases. However there is no explicit mention of ISV certification programs (e.g., Adobe, Autodesk, DaVinci Resolve certifications) or dedicated professional driver support documentation, and no independent corroboration of creator-app acceleration claims. Missing for 10: ISV-certified driver documentation, third-party creator-app benchmark/validation, independent corroboration of encoder claims.
